title: Beta customer shortlist + onboarding plan for SIEM-ready audit export (Splunk/Datadog/S3)
creator: Naomi Feldman
body:
## Goal
Select 3–5 design partners for SIEM-ready audit export (beta) and define an onboarding plan that coordinates CS/SE + Eng + Security, including each customer’s required sink(s) and constraints (VPC/on-prem, data residency, auth/KMS requirements).

This ticket is about *who* we onboard first and *how* we onboard them (checklists, comms, readiness gates). It is not the engineering implementation (tracked under ENG-13920).

---

## Beta selection criteria (must-have)
- Clear SIEM/audit log driver (SOC2/ISO evidence, incident response, admin activity monitoring).
- Willing to run with beta limitations (at-least-once delivery; duplicates possible; limited sinks: Splunk HEC, Datadog Logs intake, S3).
- Has someone who can own SIEM integration on their side (SecOps / Platform Eng).
- Can commit to 30–45 min weekly check-in for first 4 weeks.
- Accepts schema v1 as published (no bespoke field mapping in beta).

## Beta selection criteria (nice-to-have)
- Mix of deployment modes: Hosted/Dedicated + at least one Private.
- Mix of sinks: ensure we validate Splunk HEC ACK behavior, Datadog throttling behavior, and S3 partitioning/idempotency.
- At least one regulated customer to pressure-test security posture, RBAC, and evidence needs.

---

## Proposed design partner shortlist
| Customer | Stage | Deployment mode | Primary sink(s) | Constraints / notes | Proposed SE/CS owner |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Financial (HubSpot 11842) | Security review (prospect) | Hosted or Dedicated (pref Dedicated) | Splunk HEC | Regulated financial services. Wants strong audit retention controls and SOC2/ISO evidence story. Likely requires Splunk index guidance + HEC ACK enabled. Data residency: US-only preferred. | Fatima Noor + CS (TBD) |
| Echelon Health (HubSpot 11903) | POC | Hosted | Datadog Logs intake | Datadog-centric observability. HIPAA-adjacent constraints. Strong ask: filtering to reduce volume/cost and avoid noisy events. Data residency: US. | Fatima Noor |
| Altitude Defense (HubSpot 12117) | Private eval | Private (on-prem/VPC) | S3 (S3-compatible acceptable) | Government-adjacent. Requires KMS integration story (SSE-KMS), tight egress controls, and clear delivery guarantees. Data residency: US-only. Needs Private install notes + network allowlist. | Colin O’Donnell |
| Stonewire Software (HubSpot 12188) | Existing customer expansion | Dedicated | Splunk HEC (primary), interested in S3 archive (secondary) | Wants admin/audit events in SIEM; asks about roadmap to more sinks beyond Splunk/Datadog. Good candidate for validating “non-prospect” expansion motion. Data residency: EU region may be requested depending on BU. | Solutions Eng (TBD) |

Recommendation: onboard the first three as the core beta cohort (Splunk + Datadog + Private/S3). Keep Stonewire as “beta wave 2” depending on capacity and EU/data residency readiness.

---

## Sink needs + validation goals per customer
### 1) Northbridge Financial — Splunk HEC
Validation goals:
- HEC token creation + index selection guidance is workable for SecOps.
- HEC ACK mode works with our batching/ack checkpointing (at-least-once) and we expose meaningful error states.
- Duplicate handling guidance is accepted (dedupe key = event_id; optionally (event_id, destination_id)).

### 2) Echelon Health — Datadog logs intake
Validation goals:
- Regional intake endpoint selection and tagging strategy (service/env/workspace) yields useful dashboards.
- 429/throttling behaviors are stable; retries/backoff do not create long tail delivery latency.
- Filters are sufficient to cut volume (include/exclude by event_type + actor + environment).

### 3) Altitude Defense — Private + S3
Validation goals:
- Private packaging + config UX works (Helm/installer knobs, secrets injection).
- S3 partitioning/object naming is compatible with downstream ingestion and supports replays.
- SSE-KMS story is acceptable (customer-managed CMK) and audit export credentials are handled per Private guidance.

---

## Onboarding plan (per customer)
### Phase 0 — Internal readiness gate (before giving access)
Owner: Naomi Feldman + Sean Gallagher
Checklist:
- Feature flag allowlist ready (tenant/workspace IDs confirmed).
- Runbook draft exists for backlog/replay + connector failures.
- Dashboard baseline exists (success rate, delivery latency, backlog depth, DLQ volume).
- Customer-facing setup guide draft ready for the sink(s) they’ll use.

### Phase 1 — Kickoff + beta agreement
Owner: Solutions Eng (Fatima/Colin) + Naomi
- Confirm success metrics: delivery latency target, completeness expectations, and escalation path.
- Confirm sink details:
  - Splunk: HEC endpoint, token, index, ACK preference.
  - Datadog: site (US/EU), API key scoping, intake endpoint.
  - S3: bucket, region, SSE-KMS key ARN, prefix conventions.
- Confirm constraints:
  - Data residency requirements (US-only / EU-only).
  - Egress allowlists (Private).
  - Retention expectations (clarify: exporter does not change Redwood retention; it is a forwarder).

### Phase 2 — Technical setup (working session)
Owner: Solutions Eng
- Create destination in Console (or via API if Console not ready for their environment).
- Configure filters with safe defaults (start narrower; expand after verification).
- Send test event; verify it appears in SIEM.
- Confirm parsing/field extraction:
  - event_id, occurred_at, actor.*, tenant/workspace, event_type, request_id.

### Phase 3 — Soak + weekly check-ins (first 4 weeks)
Owner: Solutions Eng + SRE escalation as needed
- Weekly agenda:
  1) Review delivery latency and error rates
  2) Confirm event volume vs expectations
  3) Review duplicates and dedupe implementation
  4) Capture missing event types or schema issues
  5) Review any connector throttling/auth rotation events

### Phase 4 — Close-out (beta exit criteria)
Owner: Naomi
- Written feedback captured (what worked, what blocked rollout).
- Confirm which items are GA blockers vs post-GA.
- Produce 1–2 customer quotes or case-study-ready bullets (internal-only for now).

---

## Coordination / owners
- Product (overall): Naomi Feldman
- Beta program execution cadence: Talia Benson (if bandwidth)
- Regulated customer onboarding: Fatima Noor
- Private customer onboarding: Colin O’Donnell
- Security questions + schema/PII: Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei
- SLOs/dashboards + operational readiness: Sean Gallagher / Allison Grant

---

## Open questions
1) Data residency: do we support EU-hosted export destinations in beta, or US-only initially?
2) Private: do we support “S3-compatible” endpoints explicitly in beta docs, or only AWS S3?
3) Splunk: do we default to HEC ACK on or off? (Need a clear recommendation and impact on throughput/latency.)
4) Contract language: do we require beta addendum for at-least-once semantics + duplicates?

---

## Next actions
- [ ] Confirm technical contacts and constraints for each shortlisted customer (SEs to fill in).
- [ ] Confirm tenant/workspace IDs for allowlist + planned enablement date.
- [ ] Schedule onboarding sessions (2 × 60 min per customer: setup + follow-up).
- [ ] Align internal go/no-go checklist with SRE (dashboards + runbook readiness).
